args.sql:
SELECT
    f.tierstep AS tier_category,
    COUNT(f.userregistry) AS count_of_fans,
    AVG(f.ptsval) AS average_points,
    AVG(ms.spendusd) AS average_spending_amounts
FROM
    fans AS f
LEFT JOIN
    membershipandspending AS ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot
GROUP BY
    tier_category
